IC1: - Eligible for the early supported discharge pathway this includes:
IC2: - Confirmed diagnosis of a new stroke.
IC4: - Able to consent to being in the study.
IC5: - The patient [AND] and their family/carer agree to rehabilitation process continuing at home.
IC6: - The home environment is conducive to the community-based rehabilitation.
IC7: - Achievable rehabilitation goals can be identified.
IC8: - Document acknowledgement that the patient is sufficiently well enough from a medical perspective to be managed in the community.
IC9: - The patient's language and/or cognitive skills are at a level for them to manage on their own for periods as is necessary.
IC10: In addition to ESSD criteria participants must;
IC11: - Have a good grasp of the English language
IC12: - Have been discharged from the ESSD pathway
